|game_text=Deploy on table. Once per game, if Obi-Wan on table, may deploy Vader from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. |errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB7-03-I_Want_Every_Part_Of_This_Ship_Checked-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked]] (original, release sheet of 18 June 2010); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Obi-Wan on table, may ▼ Vader. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ a [Grabber]. If you just attempted to ▼ or ▲ a card, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card; reshuffle.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010), page 3, slip 10 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=27, page 27. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=27 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “If you just attempted to ▼ or ▲ a card” to “If you just attempted to take a card into hand or deploy a card from Reserve Deck” and “for that card; reshuffle.” to “for that card instead.”: “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Obi-Wan on table, may deploy Vader from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Used Pile to take a [Grabber] into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you just attempted to take a card into hand or deploy a card from Reserve Deck, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card instead.”<ref name="cl-1271_10-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list writes the slip's icons out (▼ as “deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, ▲ as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”); that alone is not a version. The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-iwanteverypartofthisshipchecked-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Obi-Wan on table, may ▼ Vader. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ a [Grabber]. If you just attempted to ▼ or ▲ a card, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card; reshuffle.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “10” at the bottom right, which the release-sheet slip does not.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 27)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Once per game, if Obi-Wan on table, may ▼ Vader. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ a [Grabber]. If you just attempted to ▼ or ▲ a card, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card; reshuffle.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1271-10-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image do).
